ctx.x: Well, I wrote for Gus Arnner and and I wrote for him (inaudible). I wrote for Earl Hines; I wrote for Jerry Jerome as I told you as staff arranger for NBC. I wrote for Billy Eckstein, Sarah Vaughn, and I wrote for Teddy Wilson when he was at CBS with his program. And I wrote for Fletcher Henderson, I wrote for Dizzy Gillespie, I wrote for Woody Herman, I wrote for Gene Krupa, I wrote for Auld George Yorks, I wrote for Ina Rae Hutton, I wrote for Boyd Rabin, and I wrote for Jimmy Noon.

Clarinet player. Wrote for Louis Armstrong, wrote for George E. Lee, John Kirby, I wrote -- used to write a lot of arrangements for RCA Victor. They would call me in to do different things, even with springs. That's way back. I wrote for Decca Records, I wrote -- I was musical director for Atlantic Records, I wrote for MGM Records when Ivory Joe Hunter was singing for them and we did this tune "I Almost Lost My Mind."
